domains.title: Domains or website URLs
domains.description: Sites to check, e.g. ["nytimes.com","https://www.stripe.com"]. A bare domain is checked at https:// and follows redirects (e.g. to www). Each host is checked once.

bots.title: AI crawlers to check
bots.description: Leave empty to check all 23 known crawlers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Meta, Amazon, DuckDuckGo, Mistral, Common Crawl, ByteDance, Cohere and Diffbot.

customUserAgents.title: Extra user-agent tokens
customUserAgents.description: Any other crawler tokens to check against robots.txt, e.g. ["YouBot","Timpibot"]. Up to 20.

testPath.title: Path to test
testPath.description: Path the bot rules are evaluated for (and the page whose meta robots is read). Default "/" (the whole site). Use e.g. "/blog/" to check a section.

checkLlmsTxt.title: Check llms.txt and llms-full.txt
checkLlmsTxt.description: Look for /llms.txt (title, summary, sections, link count) and /llms-full.txt.

checkHomepage.title: Check page meta robots
checkHomepage.description: Fetch the tested page (only if robots.txt allows generic crawlers) and report meta robots, X-Robots-Tag, noindex, noai and noimageai.

includeBotDetails.title: Include per-bot details
includeBotDetails.description: Add the bots array (operator, purpose, access, matched user-agent and rule for each crawler). Turn off for compact rows; the blocked/allowed lists stay.

datasetId.title: Read domains from a dataset
datasetId.description: Optional dataset ID from another Actor run (e.g. a lead list or Google Maps scrape). Domains are read from domainField.

domainField.title: Dataset field with the domain
domainField.description: Field to read from datasetId, e.g. "website". Auto-detected from domain, website, url and similar if empty.

maxDomains.title: Max domains
maxDomains.description: Stop after this many unique domains (1-100000). Default 1000.
